around them. Showing a view is up to it, with [`show_list`](Self::show_list).

795.name: caption_of
795.docs: What names a record, for lists to pick from.

668.name: read_only
668.docs: It shows but does not change.

995.name: width
995.docs: The width of the window. 440 by default.

2757.name: from_texts
2757.docs: The texts of a catalog, in its language. What it does not have comes from English.

3084.name: set_access_words
3084.docs: The words of what screen readers hear, from the language of the application unless given.

1649.name: model_editor
1649.docs:
The application's model as a tree, whose settings a person who can may change, in their own
layer. It is kept simple on purpose: a tree with its settings beside it, one at a time.

868.name: FormText
868.docs: What the window of a form says.

1522.name: active_filter
1522.docs: What this list asks of its records now.

3611.name: FILTERS
3611.docs: Picks a filter ready on the list.

1068.name: NO_END_MINUTES
1068.docs: How long a record with no end shows, in minutes.

2703.name: filter
2703.docs: The menu of the filters ready on a list.

3030.name: restore_model_settings
3030.docs: Throws away the person's own changes to the model, if they may.

2903.name: siblings
2903.docs: The keys of the list a form came from, for moving between records.

1141.name: Shown
1141.docs: A view that says what is missing instead of showing something wrong.

3230.name: header
3230.docs: Where the view is, and the commands.

33.name: ListEditorRequest
33.docs: What a list editor is asked to show: the records as the list reads them, and how to act on them.

2122.name: set_time
2122.docs:
Changes when a record reminds, in a commit of its own. A person who cannot write only stops
seeing it for now.

3103.name: open_view
3103.docs: Shows a list, asking first if that would lose changes.

2068.name: reminders
2068.docs:
Reminders that come up by themselves when they are due. Nothing runs in between: the screen asks
to be built again at the next time due, and reads again when records change.

3049.name: variant_editor
3049.docs: The list editor the way picked to see this list asks for, if it says.

52.name: administrator_settings
52.docs:
What the administrator of an installation set in the model, as a difference in JSON. Fields
it adds to an entity reach storage too.

3122.name: delete
3122.docs: Takes away these records and keeps that, in the frame's unit of work.

2868.name: ControlFactory
2868.docs: Makes a control an application registered.

4176.name: live_expose
4176.docs: Registers this crate's types with a playground's interpreter (feature `live`).

2741.name: must_change_password
2741.docs: Why they have to choose one now.

3068.name: of
3068.docs: The session an action is running in.

1633.name: literal
1633.docs: `text` as a literal of the expression language.

1960.name: version
1960.docs:
Reads this while building, and reads the records again when it changes, for what
the rest of the application does to them.

1506.name: new
1506.docs: The list of this view in the model, reading through this frame.

71.name: list_editor
71.docs: A way to show a list, for the model to pick by name.

4122.name: formatted
4122.docs: A value as its field's `display_format` asks.

2687.name: save_and_new
2687.docs: Keeps the changes and starts another.

798.name: lookup_filter
798.docs: What the records of a reference have to meet, given the record being edited.

998.name: FormCaption
998.docs:
Says what a field of a form is called, for a field and the record as it stands, when that
depends on the record; nothing means the usual.

3087.name: revision
3087.docs: Goes up whenever records may have changed; reading it builds again when they do.

1325.name: columns
1325.docs: The fields the list shows, with what their columns say.

217.name: OwnActions
217.docs: The actions an application declared one by one, as a module.

871.name: new
871.docs: A window with this title and this button.

1198.name: Summary
1198.docs: How the values of one bar or point come together.

3614.name: UNLINK
3614.docs: Takes records off a list inside a form, without removing them.

2706.name: save_file
2706.docs: Takes a file out, to wherever people say.

3033.name: show_full
3033.docs:
Shows this in place of the view, with the navigation still around it, until
[`close_full`](Self::close_full) or going anywhere else.

2906.name: announcer
2906.docs: Where screen readers hear what changed, and in which words.

1090.name: names_of
1090.docs: What names each record of the entity a reference points to.

3052.name: use_model_store
3052.docs: Keeps the person's own layer of the model there, and reads what is there now.

1817.name: add
1817.docs: The button that keeps a new record.

55.name: collection_of
55.docs: The records of a list no storage keeps, inside a form of this entity.

3125.name: first_view
3125.docs: The first thing in the navigation, where the application opens.

2998.name: list_records
2998.docs: The records of a list, the way it chose to see them, as this person can read them.

2744.name: model_editor
2744.docs: The editor of the application's model.

1509.name: cell_text
1509.docs: Says what a cell shows, when its value alone is not it.

74.name: seed
74.docs: What is in its records when it opens, kept with a commit once this is done.

params.name: impl FnOnce(&mut dyn ObjectSpace) -> Result<(), String> + 'static

2817.name: watched
2817.docs: The same, reading the fields for the build, so what depends on them follows.

2363.name: texts
2363.docs:
Adds or replaces words, as [`App::texts`] does, for the screen of signing in and for the
application of each person.

3017.name: use_records
3017.docs: Gives the records of an entity no storage keeps, for its list and its forms.

801.name: reference_select
801.docs: A reference picked from a list of all its choices, for the few records of a register.

1001.name: start_edit
1001.docs: Opens on the record with this key, changed by `fill` first. Nothing happens if it is gone.

3090.name: violations_of
3090.docs: What this record fails in this context.

1328.name: on_select
1328.docs: Says which records are selected, which turns actions on and off.

620.name: note_of
620.docs: What the rules only want known about a field.

2709.name: conflict_question
2709.docs: The question when someone else changed the same fields, where `{0}` is which ones.

312.name: parameter_of
312.docs: What was typed, as what the action asks for, or the words of a person who cannot read it.

2728.name: user_name
2728.docs: The name someone signs in with.

3055.name: choose_list_editor
3055.docs: Shows this list with the editor of this name, which stays in the person's own layer.

1493.name: CellText
1493.docs: What a cell says instead of its value, for a field and a record; nothing means its value.

1820.name: edit_row
1820.docs: The button of a row that opens its form, before the record's name.

58.name: texts
58.docs:
Adds or replaces words of its screens, and of any component in them, as a flat JSON of keys
in the language of this code: `{ "ui.save": "Gravar" }`. The keys that come with it are in
`ravenrs-app-i18n`; keys of its own, for its modules, go here too, and screens read them with
[`Session::texts`](crate::Session::texts). Given more than once, the last one wins.

3128.name: execute_after_warnings
3128.docs: Runs an action, asking first about what its contexts only warn of.

4109.name: values
4109.docs: Between what records hold and what controls show.

1766.name: NestedList
1766.docs: A list inside a form, in a frame of its own. What links and unlinks is kept right away.

1639.name: edit_on_list
1639.docs:
Keeps a value changed right on a list, in the record as storage has it now, if its rules let it
stand: a field already wrong elsewhere on the record does not stop it, and what only warns goes
on with a message.

858.name: on_leave
858.docs: What tells a session the keyboard left a field, when its form checks on leaving.

1512.name: sort
1512.docs: Orders the records by this field, after what was already asked for.

77.name: storage
77.docs: Keeps records elsewhere than in memory: this makes the unit of work of each view.

731.name: register
731.docs:
Registers a control by name, replacing one of the same name. The name of a
kind of field, such as `Text`, replaces the built-in for it.

1712.name: NESTED_HEIGHT
1712.docs: How tall a list inside a form is.

4128.name: editable_in_list
4128.docs: Whether a field can be changed right on a list.

2366.name: audit
2366.docs: Writes who changed what to the audit trail, in the same commit as each change.

3347.name: on_file
3347.docs:
Hands exported files over to this, with their name and bytes, instead of asking the
person where to save them.

804.name: tags_editor
804.docs: Several options at once, kept as their codes separated by commas.

2712.name: list_editor_needs
2712.docs: What a way of showing a list says when something it needs is missing.

3112.name: update_position
3112.docs: Turns moving between records on and off, by where this one is among the others.

61.name: entity_info
61.docs: Adds a record declared at run time.

2877.name: checking
2877.docs: A save failed its rules, so the form says what is wrong as people fix it.

3077.name: standalone
3077.docs: A session with no window around it, for a piece of a screen.

3404.name: popup_open
3404.docs: What closes the popup of a frame, when the window closes.

3277.name: arrange
3277.docs: Puts the pieces where they go.

1515.name: grid_shape
1515.docs: Changes the grid before it goes on the screen, for what the list has no word for.

3604.name: SAVE_AND_NEW
3604.docs: Keeps the changes and starts another.

80.name: signed_in
80.docs: Says who is signed in on the window, and how they leave.

1388.name: Loaded
1388.docs: A list read from storage, kept until something may have changed it.

1715.name: field
1715.docs: Their field that points to the owner.

2369.name: build
2369.docs: Puts it together, or says what is wrong with how it was declared.

3023.name: import_captions
3023.docs:
Takes the CSV of [`export_captions`](Self::export_captions), filled in, as the model in this
language, which [`set_language`](Self::set_language) picks.

1261.name: chart_view
1261.docs:
A chart of these records, from settings given directly, as a panel of its own wants it: the
same names [`CHART_EDITOR`] reads from the model.

4004.name: point
4004.docs: Changes what a record points to, keeps that, and shows it.

26.name: EditorRegistry
26.docs:
Which control edits which kind of field, by name. The model's `Editor` setting
picks one, so a field can change its control without touching code.

3096.name: set_on_url
3096.docs: Hands addresses to open over to this.

3042.name: set_lists_field_errors
3042.docs: Keeps what is wrong with a field on the field alone, for a form short enough to see it.

3115.name: save
3115.docs: Keeps what the form holds. Stays where it is; what is wrong goes on the screen.

1880.name: pane
1880.docs: A list beside its form, as a piece of a screen an application made itself.

2734.name: passwords_differ
2734.docs: The two are not the same.

3061.name: left_field
3061.docs: The keyboard left this field, so a form that checks on leaving can say what is wrong with it.

64.name: module
64.docs: Adds a module of its own, over the one with the actions every application needs.

4115.name: value_of_file
4115.docs:
A record keeps a file as text: its name on the first line and after it its content, or the key
its content is under when a store keeps it, which `@` tells apart from base64.

3080.name: new_frame
3080.docs: A frame of its own for a window over this one, with a unit of work of its own.

1518.name: remote
1518.docs:
Brings rows from storage as they are needed, for lists too long to read at once.
Grouping needs the rows at hand, so it is off, and searching covers only fields with text.

83.name: into_view
83.docs: Puts it together, showing on the screen what is wrong with how it was declared.

1064.name: CHART_EDITOR
1064.docs: The name of the editor that shows a list as a chart.

1718.name: NestedOwner
1718.docs: Which record a list inside a form belongs to, for the actions that link and unlink.

4134.name: key_from_text
4134.docs: A key back from its text.

2699.name: variant
2699.docs: The menu of the ways to see a list.

937.name: form
937.docs: A form in a window, for a record an application keeps in its own way.

810.name: FileEditor
810.docs: A picture or a file on a form: taking one, and taking it out again.

2899.name: popup_filter
2899.docs: What the list of the popup about to open has to meet.

3226.name: PRESENTED_WIDTH
3226.docs: How wide a window of something shown over the screens is.

3099.name: is_checking
3099.docs: Whether a save found something on the form.

556.name: FormState
556.docs: The record a form is editing: what it was, and one state per field.

3045.name: choices
3045.docs: What this list offers under `part`, `Variants` or `Filters`, as their id and what people see.

1483.name: shown_fields
1483.docs:
The fields a list shows, in the order to show them, with the key last and out of sight, so
a row can always be found.

3118.name: keep
3118.docs: Writes the record, with what comes along with it.

2337.name: show_change_password
2337.docs: Shows the person's own way of changing their password.

2864.name: FileHandler
2864.docs: Takes a file, by its name and bytes.

321.name: ActionContainer
321.docs:
A place on the screen for actions of some categories: what is in place shows, what is
off shows faded, and what does not fit folds into a menu. Keys work while it shows.

3064.name: user_settings
3064.docs: What the person changed in the model, to keep between runs.

1956.name: on_done
1956.docs: Runs with a word of what was kept or taken away.

1829.name: with_texts
1829.docs: The words that are the same for every pane, from a catalog of texts in its language.

67.name: translation
67.docs:
The model in another language, as a difference in JSON. The one for its
[`language`](Self::language), `en` or `pt-BR`, is the one used. Words of the screens, not of
the model, go to [`texts`](Self::texts).

394.name: size
394.docs: How big it is. Small by default.

1375.name: ColumnShape
1375.docs: What a column ends up as, from its field and the one the field gives.

4118.name: file_name
4118.docs: The name of a file a record keeps, without reading its content.

3010.name: show_list
3010.docs: Shows this view of the model in the frame, without asking anything.

794.name: option_index
794.docs: Which option a field holds, by its place in the list.

2883.name: history
2883.docs: Where it came from, for going back.

667.name: caption
667.docs: What people read as its name.

994.name: on_save
994.docs: Takes a record that met its rules, and whether it is new; false leaves the form open.

3083.name: announcer
3083.docs:
Where screen readers hear what changed: saving, deleting, the screen that opened. Its
region is in the window; an application says more with it.

867.name: save
867.docs: The button that keeps the record.

1521.name: Reader
1521.docs: How a list reads its rows, without the view around it, so a remote loader can keep one.

3610.name: VARIANTS
3610.docs: Picks a way to see the list.

1067.name: TREE_EDITOR
1067.docs: The name of the editor that shows a list as a tree.

2702.name: save_first
2702.docs: Where a list inside a form would be, while its record is not kept yet.

3029.name: set_model_setting
3029.docs: Changes a setting of the model in the person's own layer, if they may, and keeps it.

559.name: spoken
559.docs: A field as screen readers are to hear it, when the model says more than its label.

1086.name: field
1086.docs: The field a setting names, or, if it says nothing, the first that fits.

3048.name: dashboard_shown
3048.docs: The dashboard to show for this one: the one people changed it to, if any.

3121.name: cancel
3121.docs: Throws away what the form changed, and leaves, which is what was asked.

2013.name: row_key_position
2013.docs: Where the key is among a list's columns: after those showing, unless it shows too.

2867.name: CollectionSource
2867.docs: Gives the records of a collection with no storage, from the record that has it.

1759.name: back_reference
1759.docs: The field of `target` that points to `owner`: the one named, or the first that does.

324.name: new
324.docs: A place for these categories, in the order the actions came; for all of them, with none.

3067.name: check_form
3067.docs: The record on the form, if it meets its rules. If not, the form says what is wrong.

1959.name: beside_from
1959.docs: The window width from which the form goes beside the list. 760 by default.

4121.name: moment_text
4121.docs: A moment by a pattern such as `dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm`.

3013.name: toaster
3013.docs: What shows messages, for a screen with no window of the framework around it.

797.name: literal_of
797.docs: A value as a literal of the expression language.

670.name: EditorRequest
670.docs: What a control is being asked for.

997.name: captions
997.docs: Says what a field is called when that depends on the record.

3086.name: spoken_name
3086.docs: What names a record when it is announced: its default property, or what its entity is called.

1524.name: access
1524.docs: How the model says this list gets its records.

3613.name: LINK
3613.docs: Puts an existing record on a list inside a form.

2705.name: clone_unsaved
2705.docs: Why a record cannot be cloned while it has changes.

3032.name: close_full
3032.docs: Goes back to the view from what [`show_full`](Self::show_full) showed.

2905.name: Account
2905.docs: Who is signed in, for the window to show.

3232.name: TemplateParts
3232.docs: The pieces of a window, for a template to arrange.

2124.name: Reminders
2124.docs: What is due now, in a window, and when to look again.

1089.name: title_of
1089.docs: What names the record, for whoever shows one.

3505.name: PopupParts
3505.docs: What a popup holds while it is open.

2724.name: protected_value
2724.docs: What shows in place of a field the person cannot read.

3051.name: choose
3051.docs: Picks under `part`, which stays in the person's own layer of the model.

1816.name: edit_title
1816.docs: Over the form of a record being changed.

3124.name: refresh
3124.docs: Reads again. A form goes back to what is kept, asking first if that would lose changes.
